rationale: Butcherbird v3, rebuilt on the controlled A/B that dissolved the 'shotgun paradox': the gun was never the problem — the role machinery running without its hardware was. Now: no SPAS on the field means pure kestrel dueling (no shared focus for hydra's rotation to starve); the breacher activates only when the wildcard arms it. A/B arena 57: hydra 3-1 both modes, wolf 2-1 under live fire.
